**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline.**

§ 8.2–8.3 already delivers the full preferred RENEWAL position:

- **12-month renewals** — "renews for successive twelve-month periods" (no multi-year auto-renewal).
- **30-day Customer opt-out** — and the deadline is extended if Vendor fails to send its reminder, which is better than our position.
- **60-day Vendor reminder** — expressly required.
- **Uplift cap** — lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with 90 days' notice and no increase to prepaid periods.

§ 7 fixes Fees during the initial term and contains no separate escalation right, so there is no second uplift mechanic to police. Nothing to redline here.
